title: Dangers – Subtle and Obvious
excerpt: Countdown Day 11: All of us are posed between two dangers. The obvious one is “The Other.” The subtle one is “Us.” (Brian D. McLaren, Why Did Jesus, Moses, the Buddha, and Mohammed Cross the Road? p. 47) Learn more here: http://bit.ly/R8fzUI
body:
Countdown Day 11:

All of us are posed between two dangers. The obvious one is “The Other.” The subtle one is “Us.” (Brian D. McLaren, Why Did Jesus, Moses, the Buddha, and Mohammed Cross the Road? p. 47)

Learn more here: http://bit.ly/R8fzUI
